sources.title_zh: 我如何对抗AI脑力透支
sources.title_original: 我如何对抗AI脑力透支
sources.summary:
If you work with Claude Code or Codex from the terminal, you know this one.
If you work with Claude Code or Codex from the terminal, you know this one.
If you work with Claude Code or Codex from the terminal, you know this one.
You start a task. The AI takes time to reply, so you start another one. Then the first one replies, but the reply needs one clarification, one follow up and one side task — and each of them wants its own tab. Then the second tab's reply comes in. You juggle. And all of a
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 作者把 Claude Code 和 Codex 的多线程任务放进 git 里的 markdown 工单队列，用 owner inbox 汇总需人判断项，并坚持一次只处理一项、处理完即关闭上下文，以对抗在 20 个线程间切换造成的脑力透支。

en.title: How I fight AI mental exhaustion
en.reason: By putting Claude Code and Codex tasks into a git-based markdown ticket queue and an owner inbox for human-judgment items, the author handles one ticket at a time and closes context after finishing, countering switching across 20 threads.

en.reason: Funnelling 20 parallel Claude Code and Codex threads into a git markdown ticket queue worked by an agent loop, with judgment calls routed to an owner inbox, leaves only one context to close.

en.reason: A commenter binds multiple agent threads to projects, renders markdown through eleventy with a lightweight-token skill, and runs thisbit.ai for comments or voiceover, arguing Gemini (Argon 4)'s TUI rendering beats codex and Claude Code.

sources.summary:
Goodbye Claude, Hello Pi
21 September 2026 #pi #claude
I’ve been a longtime Claude Code user, ever since it became available in the Claude Pro subscription plan over a year ago. I remember the first time I used it, feeling giddy as it spat out messy Python code for whatever random weekend project I was working on, all from a single prompt. I’m certain that in a few years we’ll all look back at its release as one of the major drivers of this new era of software development we’re in.
Despite this,
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 长期使用 Claude Code 的作者因 AGENTS.md 支持来得太晚、VSCode 只能单会话连接，以及今年 244 次发布中逾 3/4 改动系统提示等小挫折，决定迁移到 Pi。

en.reason: A longtime Claude Code user is moving to Pi after AGENTS.md support arrived too late, VSCode connections were limited to a single session, and over three-quarters of this year's 244 releases changed the system prompt.

I’ve been a longtime Claude Code user, ever since it became available in the Claude Pro subscription plan over a year ago. I remember the first time I used it, feeling giddy as it spat out messy Python code for whatever random weekend project I was working on, all from a single prompt. I’m certain that in a few years we’ll all look back at its release as one of the major drivers of this new era of software development we’re in.
Despite this,
items.recommend_reason_zh: 长期使用 Claude Code 的作者因 AGENTS.md 支持来得太晚、VSCode 只能单会话连接，以及今年 244 次发布中逾 3/4 改动系统提示等小挫折，决定迁移到 Pi。

en.reason: A longtime Claude Code user is moving to Pi after AGENTS.md support arrived too late, VSCode connections were limited to a single session, and over three-quarters of this year's 244 releases changed the system prompt.
